intent: Build slugify-text. Input schema: object with required text string maxLength 4096, additionalProperties false. Return object {slug: string}. Use unicodedata.normalize NFKD then encode ASCII ignoring accents, lowercase, replace each group of non a-z0-9 with a hyphen and strip edge hyphens. No file reads or writes. Include a case with accented text. Do not print.

Build json-key-inspector. Inputs schema is empty object, properties {}, required [], additionalProperties false. Declare effects.read=[data.json], effects.write=[]. Read ONLY with open("/inputs/data.json", "r"). Parse a JSON object. Return {keys: sorted array of its top-level string keys, count: integer number of top-level keys}. Include a contributed case. Absolute /inputs path is mandatory; current directory /work contains no inputs.

Build csv-column-sum. Inputs schema: object with required column string, additionalProperties false. Declare effects.read=[data.csv], effects.write=[]. Read ONLY with open("/inputs/data.csv", "r") and csv.DictReader. Sum int(row[inputs["column"]]) for every data row. Return {total: integer sum, rows: integer data-row count}. Support negative integers and header-only CSV (sum 0, rows 0). Include a contributed case. The path MUST be absolute /inputs/data.csv; current working directory /work contains no input files.
